description: Use this when the user wants to know which song is in an audio or video file at a public URL (a direct link to the file, such as an .mp3). Only the first 12 seconds of the audio are analyzed, so it returns at most one song. Returns the artist, title, album, release date, label and a song link, plus optional links to the track on Apple Music, Spotify, Deezer or MusicBrainz. Each call counts against the account's request quota, like a direct API call, and a retry counts again; on paid plans, requests beyond the plan's included allowance are billed at the plan's rate at the end of the billing period. Do not use for lyrics or to find several songs in a long recording.

market.description: Optional two-letter country code for Apple Music and Spotify results (default us)

return.description: Optional services to include links for

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the audio or video file

name: recognize_song_from_url

matched.description: false when the audio was processed but no song matched

audio_id.description: Your own ID, for accounts that match against a custom catalog

links.description: Track links for the services requested in return

musicbrainz_ids.description: MusicBrainz recording IDs, when musicbrainz was requested

title: Identify a song from an audio URL
